datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Burundi administrative units for 2022. Geographic data were compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats representing spatial distributions of food insecurity phases (IPC 1-5 scale) with scenario projections for near-term periods.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys. IPC classifications represent acute food insecurity outcomes driven by underlying hazards including drought and conflict.
